title: Noise mass on the middle layer
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $y\in\{-1,1\}^{2m}$ have exactly $m$ positive coordinates. The noise kernel at the all-positive vector assigns $y$ probability whose real value is $\left(\frac{1+\rho}{2}\right)^m\left(\frac{1-\rho}{2}\right)^m$.
